description: Reads one ERC-8183 job from the escrow contract Dolphin hires through: who paid (client), who works (provider), the amount held, its status (open, funded, submitted, completed, rejected, expired), its deadline and the delivered hash. Read from BNB Chain when called, so it is proof rather than Dolphin's word.
name: get_escrow_job
title: Read an escrow job on BNB Chain
